## Landed

Gerrit change 1260 MERGED as 205935bd72 on main, with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1
(CI run 30780171149: lint, typecheck, pip-audit, optionality, artifact-probe, golden-path
and all four pytest legs -- ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 + macos py3.13 -- green). Confirmed
present in the landed tree via git fetch gerrit main.

Note on the review stack: the RED-first commit and the fix were first pushed as a two-change
stack (1259 + 1260). The first change is a test that is red without the fix, so it could
never earn Verified +1 on its own; the two were squashed into 1260 and 1259 was abandoned as
superseded. The RED evidence is preserved in the previous comment on this ticket rather than
as a separate landed commit.

NOT closing this ticket -- the closing agent owns that step.
